title: Feature Grid
description: A grid of features for a landing or product page, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then an icon, a title and a description per feature and one call to action, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the features go to two columns at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the grid goes to three columns with more room above and below at @lg.
